title: Relaunching ON Live - An Esports & Sports specialized streaming platform
thumb_alt: ON Live new version launch banner showing the app on phone, tablet and laptop

slides.alt: ON Live new version launch banner showing the app on phone, tablet and laptop
ON Live campaign: watch livestreams with streamers and idols
ON Live campaign: upgraded, interactive viewing experience

challenge: A VTVcab–SOOP product had lost momentum and market credibility at its previous launch: outdated UX, limited monetization, unclear vision, no metrics tracking, no content integrity tools.
actions: Owned vision, roadmap, go-to-market, feature prioritization, business model and P&L. Pitched the business plan and won approval from the CEO. Led a 15–20-person team across product and operations, marketing, KOL.
results: ARPPU above 100,000 VND, pay rate >1.15%, CAC about 18,000 VND (under 0.7 USD)
Purchase journey cut from 8 steps to 3; user sentiment up about 31%
